rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; same case and reply as the refresh-round ruling. w2.wages is social security wages plus social security tips, boxes 3 and 7 (iw2w3 p. 18; amb.2025.ss_wages, owner approved). The model left out the $15,230 of box 7 tips on the second W-2: $29,524 + $15,230 = $44,754, the project amount.
